bio.text: Roy Cooper is the Democratic candidate for U.S. Senate in North Carolina in the November 3, 2026 election, after winning the March 3 primary.
He served as governor of North Carolina from 2017 to 2025 and as the state's attorney general from 2001 to 2017.
Earlier he served in the North Carolina State Senate from 1991 to 2001 and in the North Carolina House of Representatives from 1987 to 1991.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 1979 and a law degree from its School of Law in 1982.
According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Nash County and practiced law in Rocky Mount.
